description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling FeaturePropertiesCreated events within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract event strategy to process the event and update a ThingBuilder accordingly.

classes.name: FeaturePropertiesCreatedStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing an event handling strategy for FeaturePropertiesCreated events, extending AbstractThingEventStrategy.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to process the FeaturePropertiesCreated event and update the ThingBuilder with new feature properties.
